results.question: 2017年每个月已送达订单的客单价中，哪个月客单价最高？(客单价=当月总金额含运费/当月订单数)
results.detail:
sql=SELECT 
    month,
    avg_order_value
FROM (
    SELECT 
        substr(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) AS month,
results.sql:
SELECT 
    month,
    avg_order_value
FROM (
    SELECT 
        substr(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) AS month,
        ROUND((SUM(oi.total_price) + SUM(op.total_payment)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS total_price
        FROM order_items
        GROUP BY order_id
    ) oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment
        FROM order_payments
        GROUP BY order_id
    ) op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
        AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
        AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
    GROUP BY month
) t
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: 2018年相比2017年的销售额同比增速是多少？(增速=(2018销售额-2017销售额)/2017销售额，销售额含运费且只算已送达)
results.detail:
sql=SELECT 
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01
results.sql:
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value ELSE 0 END))
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
  2) AS yoy_growth_rate
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND (
    (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01')
    OR (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01')
  ) LIMIT 1000;

results.question: 里约热内卢州(RJ)已送达订单中，使用过信用卡支付的订单占比是多少？(结果用 0~1 小数表示，如 0.36 表示 36%)
results.detail:
sql=SELECT 
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM order_payments op 
      WHERE op.order_id = o.order_id
results.sql:
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM order_payments op 
      WHERE op.order_id = o.order_id 
      AND op.payment_type = 'credit_card'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 
    2
  ) AS credit_card_ratio
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND c.customer_state = 'RJ' LIMIT 1000;
